name: Pythia identity truth set
about: Hard identity cases with the issuer, security, listings, relations and provider symbols each should resolve to. Public identifiers only; facts checked against ESMA FIRDS, GLEIF, SEC and OpenFIGI on the version date.

sources.firds: ESMA FIRDS FULINS_E 2026-09-26: ISIN, issuer LEI, CFI, admitted venues, relevant venue, receipt underlying
sources.gleif: GLEIF lei-records API, 2026-09-26: LEI exists, legal name and status
sources.sec: SEC company_tickers_exchange.json of 2026-09-25: ticker, CIK, exchange
sources.sec_submissions: SEC EDGAR submissions API, 2026-09-26: CIK, name and former tickers of delisted issuers
sources.openfigi: OpenFIGI v3 mapping, 2026-09-26: ISIN exists, exchange and composite FIGIs, share-class FIGI, security type, exchange ticker
sources.symbol_conventions: Yahoo Finance and EODHD documented exchange suffixes; share-class separators as '-'
sources.reviewed: primary market and trading currency reviewed by hand against the FIRDS relevant venue and the exchanges' own listings
sources.coin_registries: CoinMarketCap and CoinGecko coin ids, SLIP-0044 coin types, CAIP-2 chain ids and issuer-published token contracts
